FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of... of... (he snaps his fingers)...of VAPORWAVE!

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

KING
(nodding)
Yes! The swirling clouds, the distorted images, the eerie, pulsing beats. It's the perfect aesthetic for our empire.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to describe his vision.

KING
(to the assembly)
Imagine it, my friends. Our flags, once proud and bold, now feature pixelated, glitchy designs. Our coats of arms, once majestic and regal, now resemble distorted, VHS-tape static.

COURTIER 1 (she)
But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional heraldry?

KING
(waving his hand)
Pfft, tradition is for the weak. We must innovate, we must disrupt. Our empire will be a beacon of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of... of... (he grins)...of FUTURISTIC FUTURISM!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. Knights now wear neon-colored, mirrored armor, and the sound of distorted, pulsing beats echoes through the streets. Merchants hawk their wares, but instead of traditional goods, they peddle VHS tapes, cassette players, and old computers.

PEASANT 1 (he)
(to another peasant)
Did you hear? The king's gone mad! He's turned our empire into a... a... (he whispers)...a VAPORWAVE NIGHTMARE!

PEASANT 2 (she)
(shrugging)
I don't know, but I love it. It's... it's... (she searches for the right words)...it's... it's... (she grins)...it's MAGICAL!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his advisors, watches as a group of courtiers, dressed in their finest, most extravagant VHS-inspired attire, perform a choreographed dance routine.

KING
(smiling)
Ah, yes. This is it. This is the future of our empire.

ZORVATH
(whispering to the king)
Your Majesty, perhaps you should reconsider. This... this... (he searches for the right words)...this VAPORWAVE business may be a bit... (he clears his throat)...unconventional.

KING
(laughing)
Unconventional? Ha! I am the king, and I will not be bound by the shackles of tradition. I will lead my empire into a new era of... of... (he grins)...of FUTURISTIC FUTURISM!

FADE TO BLACK.
